question: With a real multitude of human characteristics and a real local candidate offer, does the model produce a behaviourally structured population on the LOCAL ballot alone?
why_local_only: BR1-REGIONAL and BR4 are NOT_TESTABLE_MISSING_DATA under the R0 certificate. Spending model calls on a ballot the environment cannot describe tests the packet, not the voter mind. R3 runs before R4/R5 precisely because it does not need them.

arms.population: named 2026 pipeline, seven columns per voter
arms.role: the 'before' reference. NOT paired with the other arms: the seven-column archetypes have no traceable mapping to any rich archetype.
paired treatment. The only controlled difference from A is the mind layer.

arms.protocol_difference: one voter per work item, one fresh model context per voter
arms.role: measures intra-batch contamination: in the canonical protocol all 32 voters share one call and can condition on each other.

execution_rules.model: declare the exact model id in the run manifest; the same model for every arm
execution_rules.arm_order: randomised, and each arm in a fresh context
execution_rules.cross_arm_contamination: the 2026-08-23 pilot generated ARM B after ARM A in the same context, which makes its measured V9 effect an upper bound on sensitivity rather than a clean test. R3 must not repeat that.
execution_rules.retries: only on schema-invalid output, with the identical prompt and no feedback beyond schema validity
execution_rules.regional_vote_in_output: forbidden; a row carrying regional_party_probabilities fails BR0

primary_measures: unique LOCAL probability vectors out of N
mean pairwise L1 distance between voters on LOCAL
mean top1-top2 margin and exact-tie rate
unique POVs, first-person rate, analyst-jargon count, out-of-diet candidate mentions
paired_measures: A vs B: per-archetype L1 on LOCAL, turnout delta, change in the set of top options
B vs C: same measures, isolating intra-batch conditioning

success_criterion.statement: R3 succeeds if the testable gates pass and the A-vs-B contrast is large enough to be a mechanism rather than second-pass noise.
success_criterion.mechanism_threshold: mean paired L1 on LOCAL must exceed 20 percent of the mean pairwise L1 between voters. The 2026-08-23 pilot measured 4.3 percent, which is noise.
success_criterion.failure_is_informative: If B does not separate from A, the voter mind does not use the added human substance, and no further data collection will fix that.

forbidden: any dual-ballot model call before R4 and R5 have collected the missing layers
repairing a gate inside the prompt
presenting a programme scaffold as a programme
reusing the local ballot as a regional surface
any forecast claim; agentic lambda stays 0
artifacts_to_freeze: the P3 data-layer certificate used to build the arms
the V8.1 and V9.1 environment manifests per arm
prompt, schema and per-arm context sha256
the V8.1 testability-aware audit per arm and the paired comparison
boundary: R3 evaluates behavioural realism of a synthetic society. It is not an electoral forecast, and no historical out-of-sample validation has been performed.
